Work with me

Special valuation counsel

I serve as special valuation counsel to owners of closely held businesses and to the attorneys who represent them. The engagement is usually narrow and high-stakes: the worth of a business, or of one owner's share of it, is at the center of a dispute or a transaction, and the number has to hold up.

That work takes a few recurring shapes. In a business divorce or oppression case, I build or attack the valuation that decides the buyout. In a matrimonial matter, I value the business under the standard that governs and explain why it differs from what a sale would bring. In a tax controversy, I help construct the appraisal record before the gift, not after the notice. And when a valuation report needs to be dismantled, I know where adversarial reports break — and how to make that visible to a court.

I also work with owners well before any dispute: on the operating-agreement and buy-sell terms that decide who controls the exit and at what price, and on the exit and succession planning that closes the value gaps — owner dependence, customer concentration, undocumented process — that otherwise cap the multiple years later.

If you are a lawyer with a valuation problem you would rather not hand to just anyone, or an owner facing a dispute, a buyout, or a sale, one conversation tells us both whether it is a fit.
